districts.name: Eko Crest
districts.vibe: Glass towers, beach clubs, rooftop lounges, nightlife till dawn.

districts.name: Lekka Strip
districts.vibe: New estates, toll gate, long straight roads made for racing.

districts.name: Balo Market
districts.vibe: Wall-to-wall stalls, wheelbarrows, hawkers, impossible alleys.

districts.name: Oshoja Junction
districts.vibe: Motor park chaos, danfo routes, area boys, under-bridge markets.

districts.name: Stilt Town Waters
districts.vibe: Houses on stilts, canoe traffic, sawmill smoke over the lagoon.

districts.name: Third Lagoon Bridge
districts.vibe: A 10km ribbon over the lagoon. Go-slow by day, racetrack by night.

radio.name: Hustle FM
bumpers: Hustle FM — if you no dey hustle, you dey sleep!
Traffic update: Third Lagoon Bridge is... yes. Still.

radio.name: Owambe Gold
bumpers: Owambe Gold: aso-ebi compulsory, invitation optional.

radio.name: Eko Talk 88.1
bumpers: Caller, you are on air. Please hold your generator.

districts.name: Garden Reserve
districts.vibe: Leafy avenues, expat clubs, oil-money mansions behind high gates.

districts.name: Mile One Market
districts.vibe: Covered market, fish and pepper, floods fast in the rains.

districts.name: Mile Three Motor Park
districts.vibe: Buses to everywhere, touts, mechanic village.

districts.name: Silverline Waterfront
districts.vibe: Jetties, boat taxis, mangrove channels that go on forever.

districts.name: Delta Basin Industrial Yard
districts.vibe: Pipelines, tank farms, gantry cranes, flare stacks lighting the night.

districts.name: Platform Ekene-9
districts.vibe: A steel island at sea, reached only by supply vessel or helicopter.

radio.name: Garden Groove
bumpers: Garden Groove — the only thing in PH smoother than the creek at dawn.

radio.name: Creek Talk Radio
bumpers: If you see soot on your windscreen, that is not prophecy. That is pollution.

districts.name: Central Axis
districts.inspiredBy: Central Business District / Three Arms Zone
districts.vibe: Monumental fictional government buildings: Grand Unity Hall, Federal Unity Secretariat, the Assembly Dome.

districts.name: Maiden Hills Estates
districts.vibe: Embassies, gated mansions, more security guards than residents.

districts.name: Asoro Gardens
districts.vibe: Hill-side villas of the powerful. Convoys at all hours.

districts.name: Wuze Market
districts.vibe: Ordered chaos: the capital's most honest place.

districts.name: Iron Crown Outskirts
districts.inspiredBy: Outskirts with Aso Rock / Zuma Rock-style landmarks
districts.vibe: Granite hills, the Iron Crown Rock monolith, empty highways for convoy chases.

radio.name: Capital Calm FM
bumpers: Capital Calm: wide roads, soft music, no wahala. Officially.

radio.name: Protocol AM
bumpers: Protocol AM: where every press release is 'misquoted'.

busEvents.text: A travelling preacher stands up at the front: 'Before this bus moves, we shall pray for one hour.'
A medicine seller produces one bottle that cures malaria, heartbreak and bad network.
BOOM. Tyre burst. Everyone out while the driver and three volunteers argue with a jack.
Rest stop. The suya man swears his spice is 'imported from Kano, via London'.
busEvents.choiceA: Buy a round for the row

busEvents.text: Two passengers are in a cold war over the shared armrest.
The bus TV plays a Nollywood epic at full volume. The ending is ... a 'Part 2' title card.
Checkpoint. An officer walks the aisle looking at everyone's 'particulars'.

ambientEvents.name: Go-Slow
ambientEvents.description: Bumper-to-bumper. Hawkers sell everything from plantain chips to wall clocks between the cars.

ambientEvents.name: Owambe Street Party
ambientEvents.description: A canopy has closed the street. Aso-ebi everywhere, money spraying, jollof flowing.

ambientEvents.name: Area Boy Toll
ambientEvents.description: Area boys have set up an 'unofficial' road levy at the junction.

ambientEvents.name: Task Force Raid
ambientEvents.description: Task Force is clearing street traders. Everybody running, including people who did nothing.

ambientEvents.name: Flash Flood
ambientEvents.description: The rains came. Mile One is now a lake with fish stalls floating past.

ambientEvents.name: Flare Night
ambientEvents.description: The yard flares light the clouds orange. Soot falls like black snow.

ambientEvents.name: Waterfront Regatta
ambientEvents.description: Decorated canoes, drums and dancers on the waterfront.

ambientEvents.name: Convoy Road Block
ambientEvents.description: Sirens. Everyone pull over. Seventeen SUVs pass. Nobody knows who was inside.

ambientEvents.name: Peaceful Protest
ambientEvents.description: Placards and songs outside the Federal Unity Secretariat. Capital Guard watching closely.

ambientEvents.name: Gala Night
ambientEvents.description: Red carpets at Grand Unity Hall. Valets parking cars worth more than the hall.
